documents.title: Acme Corp - Enterprise Proposal v3
documents.summary: Opportunity OPP-ACME-0001. 3-year enterprise license proposal for Acme Corp manufacturing operations. Total investment $450,000 (discounted from $510,000). Includes implementation services, training, and premium support. Payment terms: Net 30. SLA: 99.9% uptime guarantee. Implementation timeline: 8-10 weeks from contract signing.

documents.title: Acme Corp - Meeting Notes (March 10)

decisions: Use REST API for ERP integration (not file-based)
Phased rollout with engineering pilot first

open_items.item: Send ROI/TCO comparison deck to John and Lisa
Confirm implementation timeline with delivery team

documents.title: Globex Industries - Pilot Proposal v2

key_terms: Expansion Trigger: KPI targets met in pilot phase
Included: SSO, audit logs, admin reporting
